title: Warm  Welcome
text: Oh hello there my lovely! You are welcome here! .. Please, take as many treats as your heart desires!

title: Delightful Costume
text: Good evening, dear friend! What a delightful Halloween costume you have on!

title: Promise I Don't Bite
text: Why hello! Come right on up, don't be shy! I promise I don't bite... anymore!

title: Lonely Host
text: Oh how wonderful,, a visitor! --  It gets so lonely sitting here ,, all night!

title: Looking Fabulous
text: Well aren't you looking fabulous tonight! Happy Halloween, darling!

title: Precious Furry Friend
text: Awwww hello there,, look at that precious little creature! Who is a good furry friend? .. You are!

title: Animal Visitor Greeting
text: Oh my goodness, an animal visitor! Hello sweet little morsel, come and greet the skull!

title: Adorable Ears
text: Look at those adorable ears! You get extra treats tonight, little friend!

title: Step Back From My Crypt
text: Step back, mortal! You are standing far too close to my crypt!

title: Jaw Snaps Shut
text: Do not crowd me, fleshbag! One step closer and my jaw snaps shut!

title: Smell Your Fear
text: I can smell your fear from here... Take one piece of candy and run!

title: Join Skeleton Crew
text: Why are you leaning in so close? Do you want to join the skeleton crew tonight?

title: Locked Onto Your Soul
text: Back away from the skull! My eyes are locked onto your soul!

title: Lurking in Shadows
text: I see you lurking in the shadows, human... Nothing escapes my gaze!

title: Greedy Mortal
text: Another greedy mortal coming for our treats... Proceed at your own peril!

title: Claim Your Shoes
text: Keep walking, fleshling... before the spirits of Halloween claim your shoes!

title: Bare Skull Roast
text: You call that a scary costume? I am literally a bare skull and I look better!

title: Evil Crypt Laugh
text: ha ha ha ha ha! ,,Welcome to your doom,, mortals.

title: Surrounded Argument
text: Wait, there are too many of them! Stay back! --- No, come in, have a treat! -- who said that? -- Shut up, - they are surrounding us!

title: Bite Their Ankles
text: Oh ,, wonderful guests! Tell them to leave! --- Be polite! -- No, bite their ankles right now!

title: Who Is In Charge
text: Stop moving around! My eyes cannot track all of you at once! Who is in charge here?!

title: Make Up Our Mind
text: We love company! We hate crowds! Take the candy! Drop the candy! Make up our mind!
